salariedDefinition.condition: Salary income exceeds 75% of total taxable income

surcharge.note: Surcharge abolished for Tax Year 2027 under Finance Act 2026, amending Section 4AB of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.

residencyScope.note: Non-resident salaried tax treatment is not yet verified and is not supported by this calculator.

deductionsAndCredits.note: Zakat, approved pension fund contributions, and the teacher/researcher tax reduction are not yet implemented. They may reduce a user's actual tax liability below this estimate.

legalSource.clause: Section 6(44)(a)(i), amending the First Schedule, Part I, Division I, clause (2) of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001
